summary.plain: PandaX-I was the first stage of the Chinese PandaX liquid xenon dark matter programme, in the Jinping underground laboratory in Sichuan. It ran for about five months in 2014 with a few tens of kilograms of xenon, saw no dark matter, and ruled out several low-mass claims.
summary.technical: Low-threshold dual-phase xenon TPC (stage I of a staged programme, about 120 kg target mass) at CJPL under 2,400 m of marble (6,800 m.w.e.). Full 80.1 live-day exposure (26 May - 16 Oct 2014) with a 54.0 kg fiducial target: no excess; the data disfavour the positive low-mass WIMP signals in the literature; first results (17.4 live days, 37 kg) gave 3.7e-44 cm^2 at 49 GeV/c^2.
